title: 第2367章 你在找我吗第2366章 落日森林
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
第四魂技·烈焰死光：通过双眼释放出破坏性极强的烈焰射线，可有效压制绝大多数的恢复性能力。
第四魂技·阳炎爆：在精神感知的范围内引爆一次大爆炸，非火系防护能力会受到一定削弱。
‘虽然十万年魂技的威力不错，可惜终究不是机制类、规则系的，没什么太大惊喜。’
看完第四魂环技的信息后，心中没有太多波澜的楚风将视线放在烈焰金睛狮的尸体上，接着运转天魔六蚀，开始掠夺其中的营养。
站在烈火灵鸢上的叶灵鸢见到这一幕，心中思绪复杂，拥有四个十万年魂环的魂宗，这说出去都没人会信。
哪怕是她，要不是亲眼见到楚风的魂环，也不可能相信魂师能做到这一点，这在梦里都不敢想。
斗罗大陆上的封号斗罗加起来能有几十个，可是拥有十万年魂环的封号斗罗……
也许也就三、四个。
‘按照现在这种趋势，等到明年的这个时候，他恐怕就天下无敌了。’
叶灵鸢心中暗道。
就在她心中思索时，一股冥冥中的不祥预感让叶灵鸢眉头微皱，她下意识的环视四周，可这处山谷内除了已经死去的烈焰金睛狮之外，不存在别的万年魂兽。
可是封号斗罗的直觉告诉她，这种预感不是她的错觉，暗中真的存在危险，只是她暂时还没有发现。
‘既然眼睛看不见……’
念至此处，叶灵鸢尝试着放出自己的精神力去探查周围。
在她凝聚魂核之前，楚风就曾给过她一本修炼精神力的功法，虽然只是基础功法，却让叶灵鸢受益匪浅，知道要如何调动自己那庞大的精神力。
这种动用精神力探查周围的技巧，就是功法上记载的，只要精神力达标的魂师经过练习都能掌握。
……
大约半个小时之前。
落日森林的另一处。
穿的邋里邋遢，形象几乎和乞丐无异的中年男人注意到从天空中掠过的烈火灵鸢，原本浑浊的双眼顿时泛起一丝寒光。

“烈火灵鸢？！是武魂殿前两年新晋的那个封号斗罗。”
想到高级魂师大赛期间，贵宾席上的那个女性身影，唐昊心中杀意渐起。
他没想到武魂殿的封号斗罗会独自一人出现在落日森林深处，虽然不知对方的目的，可一个落单的武魂殿封号斗罗……
唐昊很难无视。
想到自己的妻子阿银当年被武魂殿前任教皇迫害，刚生下唐三后不久就不得不献祭给他，成为他的第九魂环，唐昊心中的杀意更浓，与之一同升起的还有悔恨。
要是当年他小心一点，妻子化形魂兽的身份也不会被发现，那么自然就不会有后来的事。
至于具体细节，为什么当时已经90级的他，之前一直没有获取第九魂环……
唐昊已经不愿去回忆，反正他知道一切都是武魂殿的过错。
‘该死的武魂殿，正好今日先收点利息。’
作出决定后，唐昊当即行动起来，跟上了天空中的烈火灵鸢，就在翻过几座山头之后，他听到了从前方传来的轰鸣声与兽吼声。
这一刻，唐昊知道这位封号斗罗是为什么而来了。
帮助他人获得魂环。
能让一位封号斗罗亲自出手，另外那人在武魂殿的身份必然不一般。
content_en:
The fourth soul skill: Flame Death Ray: Releases extremely destructive flame rays through the eyes, which can effectively suppress most restorative abilities.
The fourth soul skill: Yangyan Explosion: Detonates a big explosion within the range of mental perception, and the non-fire protection ability will be weakened to a certain extent.
‘Although the power of the One Hundred Thousand Year Soul Skill is pretty good, it’s a pity that it’s not a mechanism-based or rules-based skill after all, so there’s not much of a surprise. ’
After reading the information about the fourth soul ring skill, Chu Feng, who had no worries in his heart, turned his attention to the body of the flaming golden-eyed lion, and then started to use the Six Eclipses of the Demon to plunder the nutrients in it.
Ye Lingyuan, who was standing on the Fiery Fire Spirit, saw this scene and had complicated thoughts in her heart. No one would believe it even if the Soul Sect had four hundred thousand year soul rings.
Even if she hadn't seen Chu Feng's soul ring with her own eyes, she wouldn't have believed that a soul master could do this. She wouldn't even dare to think about it in her dreams.
There are dozens of Titled Douluo on the Douluo Continent, but a Titled Douluo with a hundred thousand year soul ring...
Maybe just three or four.
‘According to the current trend, by this time next year, he will probably be invincible. ’
Ye Lingyuan thought to herself.
Just as she was thinking in her mind, an ominous premonition made Ye Lingyuan frown slightly. She looked around subconsciously, but except for the dead flaming golden-eyed lion, there were no other ten thousand-year-old soul beasts in this valley.
However, the title Douluo's intuition told her that this premonition was not her illusion. There was real danger in the secret, but she had not discovered it yet.
'Since the eyes cannot see...'
After thinking about this, Ye Lingyuan tried to release her mental power to explore the surroundings.
Before she condensed her soul core, Chu Feng had given her a technique for cultivating her spiritual power. Although it was only a basic technique, Ye Lingyuan benefited a lot and knew how to mobilize her huge mental power.
This technique of using mental power to explore the surroundings is recorded in the technique, and any soul master with up to standard mental power can master it after practice.
…
About half an hour ago.
Another part of the sunset forest.
The middle-aged man, who was dressed slovenly and looked almost like a beggar, noticed the fiery kite passing through the sky, and a cold light suddenly appeared in his originally cloudy eyes.
"Fire Fire Lingyuan?! He's the newly promoted Titled Douluo in the Spirit Hall two years ago."
Thinking of the female figure at the VIP table during the Senior Soul Master Competition, Tang Hao gradually felt the murderous intention in his heart.
He didn't expect that the Titled Douluo of Wuhun Palace would appear alone in the depths of the Sunset Forest. Although he didn't know the other party's purpose, a lone Titled Douluo of Wuhun Palace...
It was difficult for Tang Hao to ignore.
Thinking that his wife A Yin was persecuted by the former Pope of Wuhun Palace and had to be sacrificed to Tang San shortly after giving birth to him to become his ninth soul ring, the murderous intention in Tang Hao's heart became even stronger, along with regret.
If he had been more careful back then, his wife's identity as a spirit beast would not have been discovered, and naturally nothing would have happened later.
As for the specific details, why he, who was already level 90 at the time, had never obtained the ninth soul ring before...
Tang Hao no longer wanted to recall it. Anyway, he knew that everything was Wuhundian's fault.
‘Damn Wuhun Palace, it’s just a good time to collect some interest today. ’
After making the decision, Tang Hao immediately took action and followed the fiery kite in the sky. After climbing over several mountains, he heard the roar and roar of beasts coming from the front.
At this moment, Tang Hao knew why this titled Douluo came.
Help others obtain soul rings.
If a titled Douluo can take action in person, that person's status in Wuhun Palace must be extraordinary.
